title: Google TPU Research Cloud provides computing support
text: Google’s TPU Research Cloud provided in-kind access to Cloud TPUs for the lab, with YongKyung Oh as principal investigator. Access was confirmed in November 2026.

title: YongKyung Oh selected for the Wooheon early-career researcher award
text: The Korean Institute of Industrial Engineers (KIIE) selected YongKyung Oh for its Wooheon early-career researcher award in November 2026.

title: Scientific Inference Lab opens
text: The Scientific Inference Lab opens at Pusan National University.

title: Silent failures at KDD 2026
text: The paper on silent failures in federated personalization appears in the KDD 2026 proceedings, Blue Sky Ideas Track.

title: Evidence standards at ICML 2026
text: A sole-authored position paper on evidence standards for machine learning was presented at ICML 2026.
